title: MoreBrick
description: Tons of brick for bricks and fun new features!
body:
This is a mod to express my view about the translation issues about brick and bricks in Chinese in Minecraft, so I won't provide the English version of readme.

I registered tons of brick of bricks in Minecraft, you are welcome to reuse them in your own mod or project under the LICENSE of this mod.

Check it out in my [github repository](https://github.com/winsrewu/MoreBrick)!
